name: Receiptor AI
description:
Connect Claude to your Receiptor AI workspace so you can search, inspect, summarize, and visualize your financial documents from email, WhatsApp, uploads, and connected inboxes.

You can ask Claude to find receipts, bills, invoices, vendors, amounts, dates, categories, processing status, extraction results, and related records. Use it to answer bookkeeping questions, prepare accountant-ready summaries, review missing or duplicate documents, and understand your export or integration workflows.

Because Receiptor AI provides structured financial data through MCP, you can also use Claude to create artifacts such as custom expense dashboards, category breakdowns, vendor views, monthly reports, tax-prep summaries, and other tailored views of your business finances.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Receiptor AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Receiptor AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.receiptor.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Receiptor AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Receiptor AI lists 62 MCP tools, including activity_search, approvals_approve, approvals_get, approvals_reject, chartOfAccounts_listAccounts, context_readiness, currency_convert, documents_bulk-edit, documents_count, documents_delete, documents_get, and documents_inspect.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Receiptor AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Receiptor AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Receiptor AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Receiptor AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Receiptor AI is developed by Receiptor AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
